entities.summary: Prince Abdullah bin Jalawi Sport City is a football stadium in Hofuf, Saudi Arabia. Also called Hofuf Stadium, it was opened in 1983 and mainly serves as the home ground for local football clubs like Al Fateh and Hajer Club of the Saudi Professional League. The stadium has a seating capacity of 19,099 spectators.
